misreadings.quote: His father now takes off his uniform as soon as he gets home and changes into his old dressing gown.
misreadings.evidence: With a kind of stubbornness, Gregor’s father refused to take his uniform off even at home; while his nightgown hung unused on its peg Gregor’s father would slumber where he was, fully dressed
misreadings.explanation: The text says the father refuses to take the uniform off even at home and leaves his nightgown unused on its peg, the opposite of changing into it; the reflection also contradicts itself later when it says he won't remove the uniform.

result.note: Only the reflection version has a clear factual error, the father changing out of his uniform; the fluid-prose version states the uniform and nightgown details correctly.
